title: A NUL character in a language string makes the save fail with a server error
notes: POST /Users/Configuration with {"SubtitleLanguagePreference":"\u0000"} (same for AudioLanguagePreference). parseConfiguration accepts it, json.Marshal writes \u0000 into the document, and the UPDATE with $2::jsonb is rejected by Postgres, so s.fail answers a 5xx rather than the 400 that other invalid bodies get. I did not run the handler end to end; the failing step, Postgres rejecting the document, I ran. The test: docker run postgres:16, then psql -c "select '{\"a\":\"\\u0000\"}'::jsonb" gave 'DETAIL: \u0000 cannot be converted to text.' The capture records no NUL case and no check covers one. Closed at the replan: The save route is Jellyfin's and goes at the cutover; the new API's input is held to the contract by JS-183's conformance check.
